messages:
Priya Nair: Quick thread: considering a brokerage layer to mediate regional degrade decisions. When a region is constrained, per-request we can: degrade to a lower-tier model, reroute to another region, or queue. Main tradeoffs: latency vs cost vs data residency. Wanted to surface options before writing RFC.

Mateo Chen: Central broker vs per-edge sidecar? Centralized gives global view, sidecar is lower latency.

Lin Zhao: Hybrid seems promising: sidecar for fast local checks (cacheable), central broker for global budget/policy. Sidecar should have simple fallback rules to avoid dependency on broker during outages.

Raj Patel: Need hysteresis to avoid oscillation when load spikes bounce around. Also capacity signals should decay with a window.

Sofia Gomez: Add eval hooks. When we degrade, sample outputs and run quick quality checks async. Also surface token-level cost delta to help decide tradeoffs.

Priya Nair: Straw decision payload (sync): action in {route,degrade,queue}, reason, degrade_model_id, budget_token, ttl_ms, decision_id. Keep heavy checks async.

Mateo Chen: Example: {"action":"degrade","reason":"region_saturated","degrade_model":"rwd-lite-v1","budget_token":"tkn-42","ttl_ms":20000,"decision_id":"dec-20260321-01"}

Lin Zhao: Broker collects sample ids and posts to eval service. Async feedback can adjust weights for future decisions.

Raj Patel: Billing: define who gets billed when downgrade occurs. budget_token must be idempotent for retries.

Sofia Gomez: Observability: inject X-Route-Decision header with decision_id and reason. Expose metrics per-tenant: degrade_rate, fallback_latency_p50/p95, cost_delta.

Priya Nair: Tenant overrides: need sticky exemptions for customers on trials or special SLAs. Also canary rollout support.

deploy-bot: deploy requested: https://ci.internal/redwood/pipelines/32124 3 staging rollout for brokerage-proto

Mateo Chen: Action items: 1) RFC draft for hybrid sidecar/broker + API contract. 2) Telemetry schema. 3) Simulator for hysteresis. 4) Define budget_token lifecycle.

Priya Nair: I'll write RFC + sim. Lin will prototype sidecar shim. Raj owns telemetry/billing semantics. Sofia will make dashboard templates. Will link RFC ticket here when created.
